The Royal Enfield Continental GT 750 is here, and it's bringing a bigger engine to the brand's iconic café racer.
Unveiled at EICMA 2026, the new Continental GT 750 is built around Royal Enfield's 743cc parallel-twin engine, shared with the Himalayan 750. But there's more to it than just a bigger motor. It gets a different chassis setup, a redesigned fairing, fresh colour options, dual front disc brakes and a new semi-digital instrument cluster.
